rule.description: Context7 MUST be queried before writing ANY code involving a library, framework, or external tool. Never rely on training data for APIs.

steps.step: Call mcp__context7__resolve-library-id with the library name
Call mcp__context7__get-library-docs with the resolved ID

triggers.trigger: Any new library or framework being used

emergency-fallback.step: If proceed: add comment "// WARNING: No Context7 verification"
FLAG: TODO re-verify when Context7 available

violations.violation: Writing library code without prior Context7 lookup
Assuming API signatures from training data
